codeReview.summary: The feature is implemented as host-level regression coverage in `Tests/SwiftWindowsCoreLogicTests/WinSwiftUIWindowHostTests.swift`, and that coverage exercises the real `WinSwiftUIWindowHost` downgrade path end to end. The new test seeds the host through the production scene-render closure, forces a batch render failure after mutating only the unaffected sibling, and then verifies that the downgraded frame render reruns the scene-incompatible deferred payload, keeps the deferred scroll indicator ordered last, and preserves replay eligibility on the subsequent downgraded frame render. That matches the feature description and the host-evidence requirement in VAL-CROSS-007.
